name: hydro

messages.content: List the observables available in the hydrodynamics emulator and describe what physics parameters it uses.

The hydrodynamics emulator provides **14 observables**, organized as follows.

### Galaxy, halo, and matter summaries

| Key | Observable | Independent variable | Redshift range |
|---|---|---|---|
| **GSMF** | Galaxy stellar mass function | Stellar mass \(M_\star\) \([M_\odot]\) | \(0 \leq z \leq 2.0036\) |
| **HMF** | Halo mass function | Halo mass \(M_{\rm SO}\) \([h^{-1}M_\odot]\) | \(0 \leq z \leq 2.0036\) |
| **fGas** | Cluster gas fraction | Halo mass \(M_{500c}\) \([h^{-1}M_\odot]\) | \(0 \leq z \leq 0.9996\) |
| **Pk-ratio** | Matter power-spectrum suppression due to baryonic physics | Wavenumber \(k\) \([h\,{\rm Mpc}^{-1}]\) | \(0 \leq z \leq 2\) |
| **CSFR** | Cosmic star-formation rate | Scale factor \(a\) | \(z=0\) |

### Cluster profiles

All cluster profiles are functions of normalized radius \(r/R_{500c}\), and are trained over \(0 \leq z \leq 0.4987\):

- **CGD** — cluster gas-density profile
- **CGED** — cluster gas electron-density profile
- **CPP** — cluster gas-pressure profile
- **CTP** — cluster gas-temperature profile
- **CEP** — cluster gas-entropy profile
- **CEEP** — cluster electron-entropy profile
- **CMP** — cluster gas-metallicity profile
- **CYP** — cluster Compton-\(y\) profile

There is also one gravity-only observable:

- **Pk_GO** — gravity-only matter power spectrum, as a function of \(k\), over \(0 \leq z \leq 2\).

## Physics parameters

The hydrodynamic observables use **seven parameters**: five subgrid feedback/black-hole parameters and two cosmological parameters.

| Parameter | Description | Design range |
|---|---|---:|
| \(\kappa_{\rm w}\) | AGN wind coupling or wind-efficiency parameter | \(2.0\)–\(4.0\) |
| \(e_{\rm w}\) | AGN energy efficiency or wind-energy fraction | \(0.2\)–\(1.0\) |
| \(M_{\rm seed}\) | Black-hole seed mass, in units of \(10^6\,M_\odot\) | \(0.6\)–\(2.0\) |
| \(v_{\rm kin}\) | Kinetic-feedback velocity, in units of \(10^4\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}}\) | \(0.1\)–\(1.2\) |
| \(\epsilon_{\rm kin}\) | Kinetic-feedback efficiency, in units of \(10^1\) | \(0.02\)–\(1.2\) |
| \(\omega_{\rm m}\) | Physical matter density, \(\Omega_{\rm m}h^2\) | \(0.12\)–\(0.155\) |
| \(\sigma_8\) | Amplitude of matter fluctuations | \(0.7\)–\(0.9\) |

The **Pk_GO** gravity-only emulator uses only the two cosmological parameters, \(\omega_{\rm m}\) and \(\sigma_8\). The parameter space is based on a 110-simulation Latin-hypercube design using \(400\,{\rm Mpc}/h\) boxes.
